name: sedation_level
intended_use: Research and decision SUPPORT: how much does a resting EEG resemble awake vs moderately propofol-sedated EEG of healthy volunteers.
not_for: detecting consciousness or covert awareness in patients
any clinical decision on its own

training_data.dataset: Chennu et al. 2016, Cambridge repository, DOI 10.17863/CAM.68959, CC BY 2.0 UK

labels: sedated = moderate sedation; awake = baseline or recovery; mild sedation not used for training
known_limits: never validated on patients or on any clinical EEG
healthy propofol sedation differs from brain injury
other devices/montages may look unfamiliar to it
